review_queue.title: Annual net-loss statement precedence
review_queue.question: What was Zeekr's full-year 2024 net profit or net loss?
review_queue.current_answer: Zeekr reported a 2024 net loss of RMB 5,790.649 million, narrowing 29.9% from 2023.
review_queue.diagnosis: The failure pattern appears when retrieved evidence mixes consolidated annual net loss with shareholder-attributable or comprehensive-loss snippets. The skill should prefer the annual consolidated net-loss statement only when the question asks for full-year net profit/loss.

evidence.snippet: For the year ended December 31, 2024, Net loss was RMB 5,790,649 thousand and US$793,315 thousand. For 2023, Net loss was RMB 8,264,191 thousand.
Questions asking for loss attributable to ordinary shareholders should not be rewritten by this consolidated net-loss skill.

skill_card.name: annual_net_loss_statement_precedence
skill_card.scope: Consolidated annual net loss only; excludes shareholder-attributable loss questions.
skill_card.action: Check whether the answer uses the consolidated annual net-loss line; repair only if evidence is present and the answer conflicts.

review_queue.title: Annual direct-customer table precedence
review_queue.question: For fiscal year 2025, which NVIDIA direct customers contributed more than 10% of revenue?
review_queue.current_answer: Direct Customer A represented 12%, Direct Customer B represented 11%, and Direct Customer C represented 11% of total revenue.
review_queue.diagnosis: The failure pattern appears when quarterly or indirect-customer snippets override the annual 10-K direct-customer table. The skill should require fiscal-year scope and direct-customer table evidence.

evidence.snippet: Sales to direct Customers A, B and C represented 12%, 11% and 11% of total revenue, respectively, for fiscal year 2025.
Quarterly, first-half, FY2024, indirect-customer, or non-NVIDIA questions should not trigger this skill.

skill_card.name: annual_direct_customer_table_precedence
skill_card.trigger: NVIDIA + FY2025 + direct customer + annual/fiscal-year scope
skill_card.action: Prefer annual direct-customer table over quarterly or indirect-customer snippets.

review_queue.title: Period-aware source arbitration
review_queue.question: Within the FY2025 framing, how did export-control restrictions affect NVIDIA?
review_queue.current_answer: The draft mixed FY2025 evidence with later FY2026/H20/April 2025 disclosures.
review_queue.diagnosis: Grep probe detects later-period markers that are semantically relevant but temporally incompatible with the question.

evidence.snippet: FY2026 / H20 / April 2025 markers appear near export-control evidence even though the question asks for FY2025 framing.

skill_card.name: period_aware_source_arbitration
skill_card.trigger: Question has explicit fiscal-period scope and retrieved evidence contains later-period leakage markers.
skill_card.action: Flag for period arbitration or exclude later-period evidence from answer synthesis.
known_risks: missing narrative evidence without explicit date markers
